description: In-app GPX path editor: create/edit/annotate paths on terrain, persist trackpoints, export .gpx — planning tool for paths and processes in the domains
wave_rationale: User 2026-07-11: 'a gpx editor as a tool for planning defining and annotating paths and processes in the domains'. GIS round-3 fleet (W-E UI + W-F persistence/bridge).
notes: Persisting trackpoints (gpx_points flat property) also fixes the gpx_pipeline session-scoped-render residual: a load-time materializer rebuilds TrackRouteMap + GpxTrackLine from persisted paths.
